children: Terra Solar Philippines, known as MTerra Solar, said on Friday its Phase 1 project has started commercial operations under a power supply agreement with Manila Electric
, or Meralco, the Philippines' largest power distributor.

Commercial operations for 600 megawatts of alternating current (MWac) of mid-merit capacity began on August 26, following the issuance of a final certificate of approval to connect by the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines.
The certificate confirms the facility met requirements to connect and operate 950 MWac of solar capacity and 825 MW of battery storage within the national grid.
Another 250 MWac under the same power supply agreement with Meralco is expected to reach commercial operations in the coming months.
The facility was inaugurated on July 14 with 1,373 MWac of solar PV capacity and 825 MW of battery storage, at the time the world's largest integrated solar-and-battery facility on a single site.
MTerra Solar broke ground in November 2024. It is a joint investment between Meralco PowerGen Corp (MGEN) through its subsidiary SP New Energy Corp
Actis' $600 million investment is described as the largest foreign direct investment in a greenfield infrastructure project in Philippine history.
The full project targets 3,500 MWp of solar capacity paired with 4,500 MWh of battery storage.
